job_title: AI Ops Consultant + Meeting Tool Subscription
one_sentence_description: Build and sell Claude Code automations for B2B SaaS ops teams at $150-$300/hr for project work, while converting the existing meeting summarizer into a $29-$49/month paid product.
target_customer: Operations managers, chiefs of staff, and heads of CS at B2B SaaS companies with 15-100 employees who are drowning in manual process work and either don't have a technical team or don't have time to build automations themselves.
core_deliverable: A working Claude Code automation deployed in the client's existing tools (Notion, Slack, Airtable, or Gmail), tested on real data, with documentation and a live handoff session. Typical deliverable is 1-3 connected workflows solving a specific ops pain point.
primary_acquisition_channel: Warm network outreach to former manager and 2 ex-colleagues currently using the meeting summarizer — convert existing tool users to paid subscribers and offer their networks a project engagement
key_dependencies: 2 existing meeting summarizer users agree to formalize as paying subscribers
At least 1 of 3 warm contacts converts to a paid project engagement within 21 days
Stripe or Wave account set up to accept payment before first invoice
first_revenue_action: Message the 2 ex-colleagues using the meeting summarizer today: 'Hey — glad the summarizer has been useful. I'm formalizing it as a paid tool at $29/mo. Would that work for you? And while I have you — is there any other workflow in your ops stack where something similar would save your team time? I'm taking on a few paid projects this month.'
selection_rationale: Scored 87.5/100. Only opportunity that activates multiple income streams simultaneously with zero build cost and zero cold-start risk. Two existing users are the unfair advantage — most freelancers never have this at week 1.

hybrid_sequencing.trigger_to_next: First paid project closed AND at least 1 paying tool subscriber

hybrid_sequencing.income_type: consulting pipeline + growing tool subscriptions via referrals
hybrid_sequencing.trigger_to_next: 2 concurrent consulting clients + 5+ tool subscribers ($145-$245/mo MRR)

hybrid_sequencing.income_type: consulting at raised rates + productized tool with payment UI
hybrid_sequencing.trigger_to_next: Monthly income from both streams combined exceeds $4,500/mo consistently
